readerNotes.line: Traced along the heavy ticked line from the top edge, around Aachen and Monschau, the Elsenborn shoulder, west past the 30th and 82d, around the St Vith pocket, west along the salient tip near La Roche and back southeast past Bastogne, east along the III Corps front south of Wiltz to the Sauer and Moselle, then southeast to the east edge in the Saar. The heavy unticked line running south from near Saarlautern to the bottom edge is a boundary and was not followed. Points are sampled evenly along the line.
